infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: DormDish shares the rider's live delivery location with the customer while a delivery is active.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: DormDish uses the camera to capture delivery proof and product, store, or profile photos.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: DormDish lets you choose a product, store, profile, or delivery photo from your library.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: DormDish may save photos you choose to your photo library.
